analysis:
Both units are base-side text of docs/developer/build.md (lines 447-1225). No patch hunks or head text were supplied, so I could not identify which lines changed or what the PR altered. This is a coverage limit, not evidence the change is safe.

The base text is build and test documentation: toolchain pins, MLX submodule pins, the metallib build, App Attest release qualification (lines 1098-1127), the threat-model review tooling (1191-1204), and Stripe and telemetry maintenance notes. Nothing in the base text is executable code or configuration.

Security-relevant statements a later pass should check against the head side:
- Lines 1098-1127 describe the App Attest qualification steps. They cover macOS 27 SDK linking, the runtime-smoke markers, and the rule that provider dispatch tests do not qualify the signed release. This bears on TB-011, T-052, T-054 and T-057, and on A-017.
- Lines 1191-1204 describe the advisory review tooling. It reads immutable Git blobs as data, never builds or executes PR code, uses an Actions secret, and has paid scanning disabled by default. Any head-side change that weakens this isolation, or that exposes the secret or state-branch writer permissions, would be a supply-chain concern.
- The pinned submodule revisions at lines 473-478 are provider build inputs. A head-side change would affect binary provenance (A-011, T-034), but only as documentation drift unless it contradicts the actual gitlinks.
- The T-041 prefix-cache statements (30-minute TTL, SSD tier) are not discussed in this file's base text.

No cross-file interactions could be traced from the supplied material.
